description: This file defines the interface for internal control server components within the Rialto project, including factory creation and control server internal API with methods for setting application state, acknowledging pings, and handling heartbeat checks.

classes.name: IControlServerInternalFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating instances of IControlServerInternal, including a static method to create factory instances.

classes.name: IControlServerInternal
classes.description: Interface for internal control server operations, including setting application state, acknowledging pings, and handling heartbeat checks.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IControlServerInternalFactory instance.

methods.name: createControlServerInternal
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IControlServerInternal instance, given an ID and client callback object.

methods.name: setApplicationState
methods.description: Informs the connected client about a change in the server's application state.

methods.name: ack
methods.description: Acknowledges receipt of a ping request with the specified ID.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Handles a ping request for system health check, with a heartbeat handler to respond.
